brand_presence: Small purple logo top right on slides 3-7, none on the cover or slide 2, large logo with credentials on the last slide
caption_summary: Starts with the keyword CTA, then a short reassuring paragraph on why fears are a sign of growth, then a medical disclaimer; no hashtags
what_makes_it_work: A parent-curiosity hook ('not what you think') followed by an age-by-age structure that lets every parent find their own child's stage, with a repeated 'what do you see / what do you do' pattern. It collected 116 likes and 123 comments.
lumebook_takeaway: An age-band structure (one slide per stage) lets a book brand mirror how its books are split by age and gives each parent a slide that is about their child.
